$comment: Portable hook definitions, mapped per host that supports hooks (Claude Code, Cursor; Codex has none). Scripts are Node so one implementation runs on every OS. `shared` files are installed alongside every script. `category` thrift = honors the `bare:` bypass; safety/telemetry/bypass = never bypassed. `args` may use {{repoRoot}}, {{localDir}}, {{hostDir}} placeholders resolved at install time. Threshold for thrift hooks: env SPRHARNESS_MAX_READ_LINES (default 400). All hooks fail open.

hooks.description: Enables per-prompt harness bypass: a prompt starting with `bare:` or `/bare` runs without token-thrift routing.
Blocks untargeted Read of files over the line threshold; directs to the bulk-reader worker.
Blocks cat/type/Get-Content full dumps of large files in Bash; directs to bulk-reader.
Appends one row per session to local/bench/sessions.csv (orchestrator vs worker tokens, models, bypass mode). Local only; nothing leaves the machine.
Blocks force-push to main/master, git reset --hard, git clean -x, and recursive deletes of root/home/cwd. Never bypassed.
Blocks the agent from reading or editing .env / secrets files. Never bypassed.
